products.name: Epic AI (SlicerDicer, etc.)
products.note: Clinical decision support; patient data exposure; HIPAA critical; FDA SaMD considerations

profile_text.body:
Epic Systems is a healthcare software company founded in 1979 in a basement and now headquartered in Verona. The company describes its mission as developing software to help people get well, stay well, and help future generations be healthier, with the patient positioned at the center of its work.

Epic's AI product line, tracked on this site as Epic AI and including tools such as SlicerDicer, covers clinical decision support and documentation workflows. The company's site describes an AI-supported outpatient office visit feature that helps clinicians arrive prepared, anticipates their needs during the encounter, and stages documentation and orders for review before the visit ends. A tool called Chart with Art, Epic's AI charting product for nursing documentation, has been adopted by nurses at Mount Sinai Medical Center in Florida, where the company says it frees up nursing time for direct patient care. The held facts note that Epic AI carries considerations around patient data exposure, HIPAA compliance, and FDA Software as a Medical Device classification. No litigation or MCP server records are held for the company at this time.
